summary.text: Brian Smith is a Republican state representative from Jefferson County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 66 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner and former Punxsutawney borough councilman, he describes himself as a lifelong resident of the district.

paragraphs.text: Smith graduated from Marion Center High School in 1987 and attended Penn State University for business and accounting, according to his official biography.

He worked in construction, heavy equipment operation and transportation in the 1990s, opened the transportation company Fastrak Inc. in 2001, added the freight brokerage Orion Logistics Inc. in 2003, and co-owns Abacus Housing LLC, founded in 2012.
Smith was elected to the Punxsutawney Borough Council in 2014 and became council president in 2016.

In the House he serves on the Liquor Control; Tourism, Recreation and Economic Development; Game and Fisheries; and Transportation committees, and he is the House Republican appointee to the PENNVEST board.
His biography lists priorities including reducing taxes, repealing regulations, energy independence, election reform and Second Amendment rights.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Lisa Gourley as his opponent in the general election.
